Return & Refund policy

Effective Date: January 1, 2025

Store Name: Jia Express

Country: India


At Jia Express, we want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. Please read our return and refund guidelines below.


1. Return Request Window

  • You may request a return or report an issue within 48 hours of receiving your order.
  • To start a return, please contact us through our Contact Us page or via email at [email protected].

2. Eligibility for Returns & Refunds

To be eligible for a return, exchange, or refund, your item must meet the following criteria:
  • The item must be unused, undamaged, and in its original condition.
  • It must include all original packaging, tags, labels, and accessories.
  • Proof of purchase (order number, invoice, or receipt) is required.

3. Damaged, Defective, or Missing Items

  • If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect product, please notify us within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos or an unboxing video showing the issue.
  • Once verified, we will arrange for a replacement or process a full refund.

4. Return Shipping Costs

  • Merchant Error: If the return is due to our error (e.g., damaged, defective, or wrong item sent), Jia Express will cover the return shipping costs.
  • Customer Preference: If you wish to return an item because you changed your mind or ordered the incorrect item, you will be responsible for paying your own shipping costs for returning the item.

5. Refund Processing

  • Once your returned item is received and inspected at our premises, we will notify you via email regarding the approval or rejection of your refund.
  • If approved, your refund will be processed and automatically applied to your original method of payment within 7 business days.

6. Order Cancellations

  • Standard orders can be cancelled before they have been processed and dispatched.
  • Custom or personalized printed products cannot be cancelled once production has begun.


We want you to be happy with your purchase. If something isn't right, this page explains how refunds work at Jia Express.


We set these policies to ensure that you are fully aware of our refund and return methods and procedures. These policies are applicable to (INDIA) country.


Thank you for choosing to shop at Jia Express. We want to ensure your complete satisfaction with your purchase. Please read our return policy carefully to understand the conditions and procedures for initiating a return.



Contact Us

For any questions about this policy or to start a refund request, visit our Contact Us page and we'll be happy to help.
